full_judgment: 22. It appears that all the issues involved in suit have rightly been framed, considered and decided by trial Court with reference to evidence and materials on record but the impugned judgment and decree of the Court of appeal below is not a proper judgment of reversal as it failed to consider the evidence orally and documentary on record and, as such, the Court of appeal below committed an error of law resulting in an erroneous decision occasioning failure of justice.
